title: Save learned values and the world specification
description: You separate numerical results from environment settings and inspect the optional download handler.

steps.description: You create the artifact directory and save Q, returns, derived values and actions, and the stored reference results. np.savez keeps these named arrays together.
You write world dimensions, slip probability, and reward settings as JSON. These settings describe the environment separately from the numerical results.

steps.question: What happens when the Colab download call raises an exception?
steps.answer: The handler prints the unavailable-helper message with the exception. The archive and download attempt follows the earlier result-saving statements.

steps.description: You inspect the supplied output. It reports that google.colab.files.download is unavailable in code-viz.
